Kaia Quigg

Data Cleaning

snowcrab_raw <- read.csv("data/mfsnowcrab.csv")

# Clean data
snowcrab <- snowcrab_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(-1, -5) %>% # Dropping specific index columns
  mutate(sex = as.factor(sex))

Create Total Success Metric (Haul Aggregation)

# Safely aggregate all physical factors by Year and Haul simultaneously
haul_df <- snowcrab_raw %>%
  group_by(year, haul) %>%
  summarize(
    CPUE = sum(cpue, na.rm = TRUE),
    lat = mean(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    long = mean(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    bottom_depth = mean(bottom_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    surface_temp = mean(surface_temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    bottom_temp = mean(bottom_temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Haul_ID = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(Haul_ID, Year = year, Haul_Num = haul, CPUE, lat, long, bottom_depth, surface_temp, bottom_temp)

Regression Models

# Initial baseline model
q1.model <- lm(CPUE ~ lat + long + bottom_depth + surface_temp + bottom_temp, data = haul_df)
summary(q1.model)

Classification Analysis

snowcrab_class <- snowcrab %>%
  mutate(sex = as.numeric(sex))

n <- nrow(snowcrab_class)
set.seed(8)
train_idx <- sample(n, round(n * 0.8, 0))
test_idx  <- setdiff(1:n, train_idx)

train_set <- snowcrab_class[train_idx, ]
test_set <- snowcrab_class[test_idx, ]

# Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA)
lda.fit <- lda(sex ~ ., data = train_set)
lda.pred <- predict(lda.fit, test_set)
table(Predicted = lda.pred$class, Actual = test_set$sex)
         Actual
Predicted    1    2
        1  346  330
        2 1143 1766
lda.test.error <- mean(lda.pred$class != test_set$sex)
print(paste("LDA Test Error:", round(lda.test.error, 4)))
[1] "LDA Test Error: 0.4109"
# Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA)
qda.fit <- qda(sex ~ ., data = train_set)
qda.pred <- predict(qda.fit, test_set)
table(Predicted = qda.pred$class, Actual = test_set$sex)
         Actual
Predicted    1    2
        1  184  118
        2 1305 1978
qda.test.error <- mean(qda.pred$class != test_set$sex)
print(paste("QDA Test Error:", round(qda.test.error, 4)))
[1] "QDA Test Error: 0.3969"

5-Fold Cross Validation

set.seed(12)
k <- 5
folds <- sample(1:k, nrow(snowcrab_class), replace = TRUE)

lda.cv.errors <- rep(0, k)
qda.cv.errors <- rep(0, k)

for (i in 1:k) {
  train_fold <- snowcrab_class[folds != i, ]
  test_fold  <- snowcrab_class[folds == i, ]
  
  # LDA
  lda.f <- lda(sex ~ ., data = train_fold)
  lda.p <- predict(lda.f, test_fold)
  lda.cv.errors[i] <- mean(lda.p$class != test_fold$sex)
  
  # QDA
  qda.f <- qda(sex ~ ., data = train_fold)
  qda.p <- predict(qda.f, test_fold)
  qda.cv.errors[i] <- mean(qda.p$class != test_fold$sex)
}

print(paste("Mean LDA CV Error:", round(mean(lda.cv.errors), 4)))
[1] "Mean LDA CV Error: 0.4139"
print(paste("Mean QDA CV Error:", round(mean(qda.cv.errors), 4)))
[1] "Mean QDA CV Error: 0.4021"

Geo-spatial Tracking and Backcasting

# Standardize geospatial dataframe mapping
coords <- snowcrab %>%
  dplyr::select(long = longitude, lat = latitude, year)

# Visualizing Density Shifts Over Time
ggplot(coords, aes(x = long, y = lat)) +
  geom_density2d_filled() +
  geom_density_2d(color = "white", alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(vars(year)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Bering Sea Snow Crab Density Trajectory (1975-2018)",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")
# Aggregating Average Trajectory Coordinates safely
coords_avg <- coords %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(
    long = mean(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Predictive Spatial Modeling
q3.model <- lm(cbind(long, lat) ~ year, data = coords_avg)
summary(q3.model)

# Vectorized Prediction for the Missing Horizon
future_years <- data.frame(year = 2019:2022)
predictions <- predict(q3.model, newdata = future_years)
predictions_df <- data.frame(future_years, predictions)

# Plotting Forecasted Coordinates
plot(predictions_df$long, predictions_df$lat, 
     pch = 21, 
     col = c("darkblue", "darkgreen", "darkred", "darkgoldenrod"),
     bg = c("blue", "green", "red", "yellow"), 
     cex = 1.8, lwd = 2,
     main = "Predicted Average Coordinates Horizon (2019-2022)",
     xlab = "Predicted Longitude", ylab = "Predicted Latitude")

legend("topright",
       legend = predictions_df$year,
       border = c("darkblue", "darkgreen", "darkred", "darkgoldenrod"),
       fill = c("blue", "green", "red", "yellow"))
